provenance.notes: Source GORDON figure reconstructed from native geometry, native ordinary labels, source Cambria mathematical outlines and individually clipped original photographs, icons, gradients and transparent effects. Literal raster word shadows are omitted to keep live text editing clean.

provenance.outlined_math_limit: Selected source mathematical fonts preserved as editable glyph outlines, not live equation/text objects.
provenance.dash_fidelity: Source custom dashed boundaries expanded into native solid segments, cubic sampling <=0.4 scene pixel.
